summary: Fix FD leak in BlobStore.getStream() — fileHandle left open if stat() throws after open() succeeds

operations: Move `fileHandle` from `const` inside try block to `let` outside try (line 309)

Add `err instanceof IntegrityMismatch` re-throw in catch (line 381)
Add non-null assertions `fileHandle!` for closure usage sites (lines 322, 341) since TS cannot prove the control-flow guarantee across closures
